component.name: CardVertical
component.description: A vertical course card (image-top layout) for course catalogs and carousels. Top to bottom: a full-width thumbnail (Image), an optional ProgressBar, the course title (Heading headline-serif, wraps), and a meta row (Inline gap sm) with optional duration, a Certified marker and a Completed marker. Lifecycle is derived from progress (ADR-025): omitted → not started, 0–99 → in progress (bar), ≥100 → completed (full bar + Completed marker); the derived value is exposed as data-status on the root for tests and page-level styling. Two sizes: sm (180px thumbnail, saved-courses carousel) and lg (340px thumbnail, catalog grid). A single component configured by props — no parts. For compact list rows use CardHorizontal; for generic surfaces use Card.

when: Displaying courses in a catalog grid (size lg)
Displaying saved or recommended courses in a horizontal carousel (size sm)
Showing a learner's progress or completion on a course tile

patterns.name: catalog-grid
patterns.description: Course catalog: a .grid of large cards; each grid cell sets the card width.
patterns.tree: Box(className=grid) > [CardVertical(size=lg, title, thumbnailSrc, duration), CardVertical(size=lg, title, thumbnailSrc, duration, progress=40), ...]

patterns.name: saved-courses-carousel
patterns.description: Saved courses: small cards in a horizontal ScrollArea; the wrapping item fixes the card width.
patterns.tree: ScrollArea(orientation=horizontal) > Inline(gap=md, wrap=false, align=start) > [CardVertical(size=sm, title, thumbnailSrc, duration, progress), ...]

antiPatterns.reason: Creates doubled surface depth that loses hierarchy meaning.
antiPatterns.alternative: Place CardVertical directly in a grid, Inline or ScrollArea.

antiPatterns.scenario: Mixing sm and lg CardVertical, or CardVertical and CardHorizontal, in the same row or grid
antiPatterns.reason: Different thumbnail heights and layout directions break the visual rhythm of a list or grid.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pick one size per section: lg for catalog grids, sm for saved-courses carousels.

antiPatterns.scenario: Asking for a status, completed or started prop to drive the lifecycle look
antiPatterns.reason: Lifecycle is derived from progress (ADR-025); a separate flag allows impossible combinations.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass progress (0–100). Omit it for a course not started; 100 shows the full bar plus the Completed marker.

antiPatterns.scenario: Packing extra data into duration, e.g. duration="12 Hours · Certified"
antiPatterns.reason: One prop per datum; the component renders the Certified marker with its icon and owns spacing between meta items.

antiPatterns.scenario: Setting a colour on the marker Icon or an inline colour on the card
antiPatterns.reason: Icon inherits currentColor; the card's CSS Module sets color.icon.subtle on the .marker ancestor, and Text owns its colour through color="subtle".
antiPatterns.alternative: Leave marker colouring to CardVertical; restyle only through tokens.

antiPatterns.scenario: Placing CardVertical under a heading that is not one level above its title
antiPatterns.reason: The title renders as headingLevel (default h3); a mismatch skips or inverts a level in the document outline.
antiPatterns.alternative: Set headingLevel to one below the enclosing section heading (h3 under an h2).

antiPatterns.scenario: Wrapping CardVertical in an anchor or adding onClick to make the whole card a link
antiPatterns.reason: The card is a display article with no interactive contract; a clickable div has no keyboard support and a wrapping link reads the whole card as the link name.
antiPatterns.alternative: Navigation affordances belong to the page layout (e.g. a TextLink beside the grid) until the card gains a link prop through a component change.

purpose.sm: Saved-courses carousel: thumbnail height size.thumbnail.md (180px), min width size.card.min.sm.
purpose.lg: Catalog grid: thumbnail height size.thumbnail.lg (340px), min width size.card.min.lg.

states.description: Lifecycle, derived: progress omitted. No ProgressBar, no Completed marker.
Lifecycle, derived: 0 ≤ progress < 100. ProgressBar between the thumbnail and the title, named by the title.
Lifecycle, derived: progress ≥ 100. Full ProgressBar plus a check-icon Completed marker in the meta row.
Content fallback: thumbnailSrc omitted → Image placeholder glyph on color.background.media-strong.
Content fallback: no duration, not certified and not completed → the meta row is not rendered.

ariaAttributes: role=article on the root, aria-labelledby → the title Heading's id (useId); role, children, aria-labelledby and title are omitted from the props type so consumers cannot override them
thumbnailAlt (pass a meaningful description of the course image, or leave the empty-string default when the title already provides context)
Progress: ProgressBar aria-labelledby → the title id
Certified/Completed markers: icons are aria-hidden; the visible text carries the meaning
